content.text: Welcome to the Chinese Festival!
Did you come here to become|a Dynamon Captain?
Let's start by testing your SKILLS!
NICE! you have great potential.|Now choose your own Dynamon!
Great choice, you will make a great team!
Now, I have something to give you...
These ITEMS will be useful in your journey.
Speaking of which,|let's find a WILD DYNAMON...
Let's find some wild|Dynamons to BATTLE!
WAIT! Now that it's weak, let's|try to CATCH it!
WOW! Your Dynamon can LEVEL UP!
We use SHARDS to do that.|Use some now!
You can SWITCH Dynamons during battle.
Let's use the Duxedo you just caught!
That's Sofia, she is a trainer like you...
Go and BATTLE her!
During battles, you can use one ITEM per turn.
Use the SKILL CAN you just got!
Dynamons and Skills have TYPES...
Use the STRONG type when possible!
WOW, you're STRONG!|But I'm stronger!
Next time i won't lose!
You got access to a new location.
Let's go there!
Hi! My name is Julian...
Let's practice our battle technique!
Maybe I'm too old for this...
Great adventure ahead, | stay safe, my dear.
Welcome to our Chinese village. My name is Mei Lian.
Our village is preparing for the Chinese|festival ceremony.
Once a year the ancient legendary dynamon|will appear during the Chinese festival at our|Chinese temple.
(What did I just hear? An|ancient legendary dynamon!)
I will keep the people in this village busy,| while I can find this Chinese temple.
Raiders, you know what you need to do!
You got it boss! We will|follow your plan!
The people in this village are preparing|for the family reunion dinner.
I'm making some noodles for the|reunion dinner here.
Those noodles are now all mine!
Oh no! That raider just stole all the|noodles I made for the reunion dinner!
Could you help me and get those noodles back?
Are you looking for these noodles?
You got lucky this time!
Why would that raider steal those noodles?
Boy, thank you so much for helping me.
This is so frustrating! Where is this|Chinese temple? I can't find|it anywhere.
